ISLAND OF TENERIFE – NEW FOR 2027!

Canary Island fun in the October sun

14th – 21st October

What's to get excited about!

Tenerife is the largest of the Canary Islands, located just off the coast of west Africa. It is renowned for its year-round warm climate, beautiful coastlines complete with sandy beaches and marine wildlife, as well as the impressive Mount Tiede volcano that dominates the skyline. So when choosing a destination for a spot of mid-late October sunshine, we thought ……. that will do!

And so we are delighted to introduce Tenerife to our schedule of 2027 group holidays. It will commence with a direct flight to the island, before boarding our minibus and taking the short transfer to the Hotel Panorámica Garden. Our itinerary for this 7-day holiday will see us explore much of the island whilst also allowing for some down time to laze by the heated, freshwater pool that our hotel boasts.

A popular tourist destination, the island offers an array of tours and we’ll be embarking on three carefully selected land tours whilst there. We’ll be experiencing a full day tour of Tenerife allowing us to see many parts, aided by commentary in English. Santa Cruz is the island’s capital and we’ll be joining a walking tour of this fascinating town, famed for its street festivals and vibrant local atmosphere. Finally, a trip to the Tiede National Park will certainly be a holiday highlight, which hosts the most impressive Tiede volcano, but don’t worry, it’s not been active since 1909! Aswell as all this, we will be taking to the water for a spot of whale and dolphin watching on an organised boat trip – amazing!

For such a small island, Tenerife really has so much to offer and we are definitely looking forward to this one.

October fun in the sun with much sightseeing, aquatic wildlife and a volcano….. anyone fancy joining us?

Where you'll be staying...

The family-friendly Hotel Panorámica Garden situated in the north of the island with rooms boasting sea and mountain views. It’s facilities include a heated, freshwater pool, plus large garden areas and free Wi-Fi.

Food, glorious food!

Our hotel will be looking after us for both our breakfasts and evening meals. Both are buffet style with a variety of dishes available catering for all dietary requirements. Packed lunches will be provided for when we’re out and about during the daytime.

Travel

We will meet at a London airport and you will be supported on our return flights to and from Tenerife. We shall be hiring minibuses on our arrival and these shall provide our mode of transportation for most, if not all, of our daily activities.

Itineray

Day 1 – Travel to Tenerife from London

Day 2 – Whale and dolphin watching boat trip

Day 3 – Guided tour of The Tiede National Park

Day 4 – Walking tour of Santa Cruz

Day 5 – Rest Day – A day with no fixed schedule, allowing us to rest a little and decide between us how we’d like to spend the day.

Day 6 – Tenerife full island tour

Day 7 – Day relaxing by the pool

Day 8 – Travel back to the UK

*Please note that activities may not be in the above order
